AFFECT [[3197972396468700595]]
TRAVERSE ?#[[214642769434]]
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
Item {
    id: smritiAskMenu
    property bool smritiArmed: false
    property var smritiArmedRequest: null
    visible: smritiArmed && typeof sceneController !== "undefined"

    function smritiReadArmed() {
        if (!smritiArmedRequest) smritiArmedRequest = new XMLHttpRequest();
        smritiArmedRequest.onreadystatechange = function() {
            if (smritiArmedRequest.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE)
                smritiAskMenu.smritiArmed = smritiArmedRequest.responseText.indexOf("1") === 0;
        };
        smritiArmedRequest.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.smriti/armed");
        smritiArmedRequest.send();
    }

    function smritiSend(action) {
        // TODO(selection-rect): replace auto with the firmware's selected-item
        // bounds after deploy/probe-selection.sh identifies the 3.27 property.
        // Send before clearing: daemon screenshot fallback needs the marquee.
        var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
        request.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.smriti/eye-cmd");
        request.send("focus " + action + " auto scene");
        sceneController.clearSelectedItems();
        if (typeof documentViewTools !== "undefined")
            documentViewTools.activeTool = "primary";
    }

    Component.onCompleted: smritiReadArmed()

    Row {
        spacing: 4
        ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
            ~&214632764553&~: "Ask"
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiAskMenu.smritiSend("ask") }
        }
        ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
            ~&214632764553&~: "Solve"
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiAskMenu.smritiSend("solve") }
        }
        ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
            ~&214632764553&~: "Plot"
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiAskMenu.smritiSend("plot") }
        }
        ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
            ~&214632764553&~: "Draw"
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiAskMenu.smritiSend("draw") }
        }
        ~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
            ~&214632764553&~: "Explain"
            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiAskMenu.smritiSend("explain") }
        }
    }
}
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
